description.value: The Cabins at Terrace Beach is a west coast cabin resort established in 2002, perched above Terrace Beach in Ucluelet with direct access to the Wild Pacific Trail's Lighthouse Loop. The property offers a range of accommodation from contemporary passive-built oceanfront cabins with Pacific views to rainforest loft cabins nestled in old-growth forest, most of which are pet friendly and include private parking stalls. Touring cyclists riding the Pacific Rim corridor would find it a scenic basecamp with immediate trail access and a full kitchen in every unit.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, legitimate cabin resort at this Ucluelet address with multiple cabin types, private parking per cabin, and WiFi — an expansion notice is visible, confirming the business is operating. No mention of bike-specific storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying area, or e-bike charging appears anywhere in the fetched content. The website prominently displays a toll-free number (1-866-GET-HERE) rather than the OSM local number, and the physical address is not explicitly corroborated in the pages captured.
concerns: OSM phone +1-250-726-2101 is not corroborated by fetched website pages, which prominently display only the toll-free number 1-866-GET-HERE (1-866-438-4373); both may be valid but the local number cannot be confirmed.
Physical address not explicitly confirmed in fetched website content — the 'Getting Here' page was not captured.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate accommodation on the Pacific Rim cycling corridor with direct Wild Pacific Trail access, but the website contains no evidence of secure bike storage or staff bike procedures — the two required WWC criteria. Direct outreach is needed to confirm eligibility.
